title: 第7章 回归道院第8章 受命于天
content_zh:
青云府道院，惠春县分院。
午后的日头毒辣，白花花地挂在当空，像是个不知疲倦的火炉，恣意炙烤着山脚下的连片农田。
这里处于道院大阵的最边缘，不比县城内院那些有着恒温聚灵阵加持的深宅精舍，灵气稀薄得如同兑了水的清汤。
在这里，一切还得看老天爷的脸色吃饭，外加这群学子们半吊子的法术伺候。
空气中，除了令人窒息的热浪，还弥漫着一股刺鼻的硫磺与草木灰混合的怪味儿。
那是道院刚刚发放的劣质“灭蝗散”的味道。
几名身穿灰色粗布短打的学子，正佝偻着腰，如同暴晒下的虾米，在田垄间艰难穿梭。
他们背上背着半人高的沉重铜皮药箱，手里擎着长长的喷杆，随着手臂机械地按压，喷嘴里吐出断断续续的淡黄色药雾。
这几人，皆是农科“外舍”的学生。
在大周那等级森严如同金字塔般的道院体系里，“外舍”二字，往往就意味着资质平平，家世普通。
换句不好听的市井俚语，那便是这一届科举修仙大潮中的“陪跑者”与“耗材”。
“这该死的世道，这该死的鬼天气！”
一个身材微胖，脸上满是油汗与泥点子混合物的学子直起腰，只觉得脊椎骨发出一阵不堪重负的咔吧声。
他狠狠地抹了一把迷住眼睛的汗水，愤愤骂道。
他叫王虎，入道院整整三年了，修为还在聚元一层晃荡，卡在那临门一脚上，死活迈不过去。
“连道院名下的农田都进了蝗虫，这哪里是什么天灾？
分明是那帮司农监的老爷们尸位素餐！
平日里一个个眼高于顶，这时候连个护田的结界都懒得维护，全指望咱们这些外舍弟子拿命去填！”
王虎一边骂，一边看着脚边几只被药粉熏得半死不活、却还在蹬着带刺后腿的蝗虫，心中一股无名火起，抬脚便是一记狠踩。
“噗嗤”一声脆响，绿色的浆液爆开，在干裂的土地上留下一滩污痕。

“省点力气吧，有这骂人的功夫，不如多按两下喷杆。”
旁边一个瘦高个儿的同窗停下手中的活计，单手拄着喷杆，无奈地摇了摇头。他叫赵立，在这外舍里算是个看的通透的“明白人”。
“这灭蝗散是道院统一配发的，说是能驱虫，其实也就那样。
咱们这修为，不用药还能咋办？
难不成你还指望这群没脑子的虫子自己良心发现，飞出咱们的责任田？”
王虎闻言，更是泄气，一屁股坐在滚烫的田埂上，也不管脏不脏了，眼中流露出一丝难以掩饰的渴望
“要是……要是咱们驱虫术能二级就好了。”
他比划了一个手势，眼神迷离
“听说那才是真正的仙家手段。根本不用这种笨重的药箱子，只消元气一震，指尖那么一点，方圆几丈内的虫子直接震碎内脏，死得干干净净。
那样的话，咱们何至于月月都是‘丙’甚至‘丁’的评级？早就拿了‘甲’，去藏书阁换更好的功法了！”
“二级驱虫术？”
赵立嗤笑一声，像是听到了什么天大的笑话，眼神里带着几分自嘲与凉薄
“你想什么呢？大白天的就开始做梦？”
他指了指山腰处云雾缭绕、隐约可见飞檐斗拱的内院精舍
“掌握一门二级法术，那是进‘内舍’的硬门槛！咱们要是能使出来，早就搬到那半山腰去住了，有人伺候，有灵茶喝。
还用在这儿苦哈哈地守着这两亩贫瘠的农田，为了每个月那点可怜的考评分数，愁得把头发都薅秃了？”
这话一出，周围几个正在干活的同窗动作都慢了下来，气氛一时变得沉闷无比。
只有药水喷洒时的“滋滋”声，单调而乏味地响着。
内舍与外舍，一字之差，却是云泥之别。
content_en:
Qingyun Mansion Taoist Temple, Huichun County Branch.
The afternoon sun was fierce, and white flowers hung in the sky, like a tireless stove, scorching the farmland at the foot of the mountain.
This place is at the very edge of the Taoist array. It is no better than the deep houses in the inner courtyard of the county that are blessed with constant-temperature spirit gathering arrays. The spiritual energy is as thin as clear soup that has been watered down.
Here, everything depends on God's face, plus the half-hearted magic skills of these students.
In addition to the suffocating heat wave, the air was also filled with a pungent smell of sulfur mixed with plant ash.
It was the smell of the low-quality "Locust Exterminator Powder" just distributed by the Taoist Temple.
Several students wearing short jackets made of gray coarse cloth were hunched over like dried shrimps under the sun, struggling to shuttle between the fields.
They carry heavy copper medicine boxes half a person's height on their backs, and hold long spray poles in their hands. As their arms press mechanically, intermittent light yellow medicine mist is spit out from the nozzles.
These people are all students from the "waishe" department of agriculture.
In the pyramid-like Taoist temple system of the Great Zhou Dynasty, the word "waishe" often means mediocre qualifications and ordinary family background.
In other words, they are the "accompanying runners" and "consumables" in this wave of imperial examinations and immortality.
"This damn world, this damn weather!"
A student who was slightly chubby and whose face was covered with a mixture of oil, sweat and mud stood up and felt an overwhelming clicking sound coming from his spine.
He violently wiped the sweat that blinded his eyes and cursed angrily.
His name is Wang Hu. It has been three years since he entered the Taoist monastery. His cultivation is still dangling on the first level of Juyuan. He is stuck on the last step and cannot move forward.
"Locusts have even entered the farmland under the name of the Taoist temple. What kind of natural disaster is this?
It was obviously the corpses of the agricultural supervisors!
Normally everyone's eyes are higher than the top, but now they don't even bother to maintain the barrier to protect the field, and they all expect us lay disciples to risk their lives to fill it! "
While Wang Hu was scolding, he looked at a few locusts at his feet that were half-dead from the poisonous powder but were still kicking on their stinging hind legs. An unknown fire arose in his heart, and he raised his foot and gave them a hard stomp.
There was a crisp sound of "Puff", and the green slurry exploded, leaving a stain on the dry and cracked land.
"Save your energy. If you have the energy to curse, why not press the spray boom twice more."
A tall and thin classmate next to him stopped what he was doing, holding the spray boom with one hand, and shook his head helplessly. His name is Zhao Li, and he is considered a "clear person" in this outer house.
"This locust-killing powder is distributed uniformly by the Taoist Academy. It is said to be able to repel insects, but in fact it is just that.
With our level of cultivation, what can we do without medicine?
Do you still expect these brainless bugs to find out on their own conscience and fly out of our field of responsibility? "
When Wang Hu heard this, he became even more discouraged and sat down on the hot field ridge. He didn't care whether it was dirty or not, and there was an unconcealable desire in his eyes.
"It would be great if...if our deworming skills could reach level two."
He made a gesture, his eyes blurred
"I heard that that is the real immortal method. There is no need for such a bulky medicine box at all. Just a shock of vitality, as small as the fingertips, will directly shatter the internal organs of insects within a few feet and kill them cleanly.
In that case, how come we get a 'C' or even a 'D' rating every month? I have already taken ‘A’ and went to the Library Pavilion to exchange for better techniques! "
"Level 2 deworming technique?"
Zhao Li sneered, as if he had heard some big joke, with a bit of self-deprecation and coldness in his eyes.
"What are you thinking about? You start dreaming in broad daylight?"
He pointed to the inner courtyard shrine on the mountainside shrouded in clouds and mist, with the eaves and brackets vaguely visible.
"Mastering a second-level spell is the hard threshold for entering the 'inner house'! If we could master it, we would have moved to live halfway up the mountain long ago, where we would have people to take care of us and have spiritual tea to drink.
It’s so painful to use it here.Guarding these two acres of barren farmland, worrying so much that your hair is bald just for the pitiful assessment scores every month? "
As soon as these words came out, the movements of several students working around him slowed down, and the atmosphere became extremely dull for a moment.
Only the "sizzling" sound when the medicine is sprayed is monotonous and boring.
The difference between inner and outer is just one word, but it is the difference between cloud and mud.
